mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following the RSAFS increase, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the unemployment signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE spikes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply contraction signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the economic strengthening signal, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the easing signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong job growth, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the job growth signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a low-interest-rate environment.
regime_hint: economic expansion with low interest rates
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the economic growth signal, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 growth and low FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
